name: Mfecane
description: Wave of violence and forced migration across southern Africa driven by Zulu expansion

name: Concession Rush
description: European concession-seekers obtained grants from Mbandzeni covering most of Swazi land

name: Bhunu Trial
description: King Bhunu tried by colonial court over the Mbhulazwe incident; major sovereignty crisis

name: Partition of Swaziland
description: British Order-in-Council placed Swaziland under direct administration; end of formal Swazi sovereignty

name: Swazi Kingdom Formation
description: Ngwane III leads Dlamini people to establish the Swazi kingdom in the Highveld

name: Incwala Ceremony
description: Annual first-fruits ceremony of the Swazi king; anchors royal legitimacy; tied to lunar calendar

name: Umhlanga Reed Dance
description: Annual reed-cutting ceremony for unmarried women; presented at the queen mother's kraal
